body:
## Stream, Cancel, and Bound Work

A long answer makes the interface feel frozen and continues spending money after the user leaves.

Streaming sends partial output as it arrives. Cancellation should propagate from the client through your server to the provider where supported.

Set maximum input and output tokens, concurrency, and deadlines. Backpressure keeps incoming demand from exhausting memory or provider quotas.
common_mistakes: API keys are safest inside public browser code.
Every failed request should retry forever.
mini_exercise: Draw “Stream, Cancel, and Bound Work” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: AI APIs let products use managed models while keeping credentials, errors, and costs under application control.
